outcome: Cesarean section for intrapartum fetal compromise (CS-IFC)
cohort: 590 singleton pregnancies across four tertiary centers in Spain, Italy, and the UK who underwent Doppler ultrasound assessment between 35+0 and 41+0 weeks of gestation and delivered within 24 hours of examination.
finding: The predictive ability of cerebral Doppler (CPR MoM and MCA PI MoM) for cesarean section due to intrapartum fetal compromise (CS-IFC) increases with advancing gestational age during the last weeks of gestation, peaking at 39 to 40 weeks.
mod_finding: The study found that the predictive accuracy of cerebral Doppler for cesarean section due to intrapartum fetal compromise improves with advancing gestational age.
